original.statement: Istio pilot no longer merges DestinationRules for the same host when their exportTo attributes are totally different; setting ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE=false in the pilot deployment restores the old merging.

corrected.statement: Istio no longer merges DestinationRules on the same host when their exportTo attributes are totally different. To switch this off, set ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE=false in the pilot deployment.

decision.reason: [ev-a25845551580] says the change is that DestinationRules on the same host are no longer merged when their exportTo attributes are totally different. The note mentions `ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE` only as a way to switch this behaviour off; it never says the env var's own meaning changed. So the subject should be the merge behaviour, not the env var. The change type behavior-changed is correct for that subject.
